description: React component for an event logging page in a real-time OEE monitoring system. It allows users to load a production run by ID and submit downtime and quality events related to that run, using various form inputs and external API calls.

methods.name: isoNow
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp in ISO format.

methods.description: Main React component for the event logging page, managing state for run data, loading, errors, and form inputs, and handling form submissions.
